text_block_list.text:
On our way back from accompanying
Super Creek on her shopping trip
at the shopping street—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We bought this, that, and everything in between,
and before we knew it, it got so late~

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey you two, looking all close over there!
Care to give it a try~?!
choice_data_list: That sounds interesting.
Sounds like fun.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then, since we have raffle tickets,
shall we give it a spin~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...And on that note,
do your best, Trainer♪"
choice_data_list: Huh, me?
Huh, me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just watching is fun enough for me, so...
Go for it♪ Keep it up♪

Encouraged by Super Creek's warm cheers,
I turn the lottery wheel.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"My, oh my...!
Winning the grand prize is simply incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This must be a reward
for you being such a good person every day, Trainer~♪
choice_data_list: This belongs to Creek, who gave us the raffle ticket.
This belongs to Creek, who gave us the raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No. You're the one who pulled it, Trainer,
so it belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Please take a nice, long soak in the hot springs
and let all your fatigue melt away♪"
choice_data_list: I want Creek to get some rest too!
I want Creek to get some rest too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...You're as kind as ever,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about
we go together~?
choice_data_list: Are you okay with that, Creek?
Are you okay with that, Creek?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
It'll make the trip so much more fun anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Still, considering the timing right now...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "It's an important period for you as well, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it! What if you made your dream
come true in the Twinkle Series?
choice_data_list: Nice, a well-deserved post-work trip.
Sounds good, a nice vacation to unwind.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm really looking forward to it♪

After making a promise with Super Creek,
I ended up holding onto the hot springs trip ticket.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my♪
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "First-class meat and carrots; a melt-in-your-mouth flavor that tastes like pure kindness," it says.
choice_data_list: That looks really good.
That looks delicious, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Oh, Trainer... you've got the face of a total glutton right now...♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, if it makes you that happy,
I'm sure the carrot hamburg steak is happy too.
choice_data_list: Hm? Isn't Creek going to eat it?
Huh? Creek, aren't you the one eating that?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who drew the 1st prize, Trainer,
so the reward belongs to you too~.
choice_data_list: Then you should eat with us too, Creek!

text_block_list.text:
When I told her that I only won first prize
thanks to the lottery ticket she gave me—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
Well then, if you insist...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now then, since we've been allowed to use the kitchen,
shall we begin cooking?♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not just the hamburg steak, I'll make the salad and soup
to your liking as well, Trainer~
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it!
I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes~.
Let's savor the taste of kindness together, just the two of us♪
And so, together with Super Creek, I savored the exquisite flavor.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...
So very many carrots...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's wonderful, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: Isn't this Creek's?
Isn't this Creek's?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. You're the one who won the lottery, Trainer,
so the prize belongs to you~.
Though she says that, winning second prize was entirely thanks to her giving me the raffle ticket.
choice_data_list: That raffle ticket's yours, so take it!
That raffle ticket is yours, please take it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well, if you insist, I can hardly refuse~
...Then I shall gladly take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I've made up my mind, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Using this carrot, I'll cook meals for you every single day from now on, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Something that everyone can enjoy eating,
whether they love carrots or hate them...♪
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry.
I've got plenty of recipes in my repertoire~.
choice_data_list: ...If possible, I'd like Creek to eat some too.
...If possible, I'd love Creek to try some too.

text_block_list.text:
I told them I wouldn't be able to finish this much alone,
and that eating by myself would feel lonely—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, how careless of me...!
Well then, I shall join you for meals as well~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
I'm looking forward to tomorrow and beyond~♪

After exchanging a promise with Super Creek,
I headed home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what lovely carrots~.
They're so glossy and look delightfully crisp♪

Hearing that, I look at the prize,
and it certainly does look high quality.

"Looking at the label, it read:
'Organic Carrots Grown in the Northern Lands.'"
choice_data_list: Then I'll give the prize to Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you sure?
choice_data_list: Super Creek's the one who gave me the raffle ticket, after all.
Super Creek's the one who gave me the raffle ticket, you know.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then if you don't mind...
Thank you very much♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, since we have them,
why don't we try planting these carrots in the field...♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If we get a big harvest,
everyone at the academy can eat together~.
choice_data_list: That's a great idea!
That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Let's go plant them tomorrow first thing~♪
Afterward, sprouts safely emerged from the planted carrots. Gazing at the fresh buds... I felt a strange sense of renewed energy!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear...
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I couldn't live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, no, as long as you enjoyed yourself,
Trainer, that's all that matters to me...♪
Her kindness only makes my frustration grow all the more.

Feeling I should at least give her a prize,
I got some pocket tissues from the prize counter
and handed them to Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay for me to have this?
choice_data_list: Super Creek's the one who gave me the raffle ticket, after all.
Super Creek's the one who gave me the raffle ticket, you know.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well then, gratefully...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san...
Please don't fret too much over it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When you look so sad, Trainer,
it makes me sad too, you know~
choice_data_list: Ah...
Yeah...

text_block_list.text: We shared our disappointment together with Super Creek for a while.
